basic_info.description: On an oversized lot on a rare cul-de-sac, this home arrests your attention immediately with its Emerald dramatic curving terrazzo staircase as though it is inviting you to come up and admire the view.  But inside the sunny, well-laid home will make you want to stay forever.  Remodeled in 2022, thoughtful touches like subway tile kitchen backsplash, complemented by a fireclay farmhouse sink, a perfect work from home office & huge laundry room make this house liveable even beyond its ample square footage and great 4 bedroom size.  Upstairs there are large living and dining rooms, superb chefs kitchen, hall bath, two oversized bedrooms with bay windows & pantry w/stairs down to a 2nd entry hall.  This leads to the garage, laundry room & 4th bed and, in the opposite direction, to the primary suite, sitting room, office & 2nd full bath.  The sitting room exits to the sheltered, sunny back garden, where veggies, flowers and great times flourish.  Close to St. Mary's rec center/ playground, a quick jaunt to shopping on Cortland, Keiko's Coffee and delectable Salvadoran eats on Mission or slightly further to the cozy delights of Glen Park and it's BART station, this home offers all the convenience of the city, the romantic comfort of the past and the space to spread out and enjoy life!
